prompt:
Scene:
Same square frame, same low horizon, same mirror ocean and camera position as the reference. The sky is now deep teal-blue with a powerful emerald aurora forming a vertical curtain directly behind the peak, filling the upper two thirds of the frame.

Subject:
The identical floating amethyst crystal mountain from the reference, preserving silhouette and fractures. Because the aurora source is now nearly behind the peak, the crystal acts as a gigantic lens: a focused emerald beam emerges from the front face and lands as a luminous elliptical pool on the mirror ocean directly beneath the center of the mountain.

Important details:
Accurate lensing behavior — the emerald beam narrows as it exits the crystal and widens again as it approaches the water. Internal caustics on the facets glow chartreuse and deep teal. The scale anchor helicopters (same positions) are now silhouetted against the green aurora and read as tiny black specks. Water ripple-free; reflection near-perfect.

Use case:
Third image in the aurora refraction cycle. Shows the same reference peak behaving as a lens under back-lit emerald aurora.

Constraints:
PRESERVE the reference image peak silhouette, camera angle, horizon, and helicopter positions. No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no cartoon treatment, no extra floating debris, no second light source, no stars (aurora dominates).
